title: Ikki marta ishi yopilgan qandolatchi keyin nima qildi?

scenes.text: 1876 yilda yosh Milton Xershi Filadelfiyada qandolat ishini ochdi. Olti yildan keyin u yopildi.
Nyu-Yorkdagi keyingi urinishi ham muvaffaqiyatsiz tugadi.
Keyin u Lankasterda karamel ishlab chiqara boshladi va bu safar ish yurishdi.
1900 yilda karamel kompaniyasini 1 million dollarga sotib, shokoladga o'tdi.
Uning nomidagi shokolad brendi bugun ham bor.

description:
Milton Xershi 1876 yilda Filadelfiyada qandolat ishini ochgan, olti yildan keyin u yopilgan. Nyu-Yorkdagi urinishi ham muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lgan. 1886 yilda Lankaster Karamel kompaniyasini ochgan va 1900 yilda uni 1 million dollarga sotib, shokoladga o'tgan.

Ikkinchi urinishdan keyin to'xtagan bo'larmidingiz? Izohda yozing.
source: Wikipedia: Milton S. Hershey (candy business in Philadelphia from 1876, failed after six years; New York venture failed; Lancaster Caramel Company founded 1886; sold it in 1900 for $1 million to focus on chocolate) https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Milton_S._Hershey ; Britannica: Milton Snavely Hershey.
